english: Did you watch the keynote yet?
context: Asking a colleague about WWDC keynote on day one

translations.pt-BR: Você já assistiu ao keynote?
translations.es: ¿Ya viste el keynote?
translations.fr: Tu as déjà regardé le keynote ?
translations.de: Hast du die Keynote schon gesehen?
translations.it: Hai già visto il keynote?

english: The Platforms State of the Union goes deeper into the new APIs.
context: Pointing teammates to the developer-focused WWDC session

translations.pt-BR: O Platforms State of the Union aprofunda nas novas APIs.
translations.es: El Platforms State of the Union profundiza más en las nuevas APIs.
translations.fr: Le Platforms State of the Union approfondit les nouvelles API.
translations.de: Die Platforms State of the Union geht tiefer auf die neuen APIs ein.
translations.it: Il Platforms State of the Union approfondisce le nuove API.

english: I'll book a lab slot to ask the SwiftUI team directly.
context: Planning to attend a developer lab session at WWDC

translations.pt-BR: Vou reservar um slot de lab pra perguntar direto pro time do SwiftUI.
translations.es: Voy a reservar un slot de lab para preguntarle directamente al equipo de SwiftUI.
translations.fr: Je vais réserver un créneau de lab pour interroger directement l'équipe SwiftUI.
translations.de: Ich buche einen Lab-Slot, um direkt das SwiftUI-Team zu fragen.
translations.it: Prenoto uno slot di lab per chiedere direttamente al team di SwiftUI.

english: This session is a must-watch if you ship SwiftUI apps.
context: Recommending a WWDC session to your team

translations.pt-BR: Essa session é obrigatória se você publica apps em SwiftUI.
translations.es: Esta sesión es obligatoria si publicas apps en SwiftUI.
translations.fr: Cette session est incontournable si tu publies des apps SwiftUI.
translations.de: Diese Session ist ein Muss, wenn du SwiftUI-Apps veröffentlichst.
translations.it: Questa sessione è imperdibile se pubblichi app in SwiftUI.

english: Let's adopt the new APIs incrementally to keep iOS 17 support.
context: Deciding how to roll out new OS features without breaking backward compatibility

translations.pt-BR: Vamos adotar as novas APIs de forma incremental pra manter o suporte ao iOS 17.
translations.es: Vamos a adoptar las nuevas APIs de forma incremental para mantener el soporte de iOS 17.
translations.fr: Adoptons les nouvelles API de manière incrémentale pour garder la compatibilité iOS 17.
translations.de: Lass uns die neuen APIs schrittweise einführen, um iOS-17-Unterstützung beizubehalten.
translations.it: Adottiamo le nuove API in modo incrementale per mantenere il supporto a iOS 17.

english: Replace ObservableObject with the @Observable macro.
context: Modernizing SwiftUI state management

translations.pt-BR: Substitua ObservableObject pela macro @Observable.
translations.es: Reemplaza ObservableObject por el macro @Observable.
translations.fr: Remplace ObservableObject par le macro @Observable.
translations.de: Ersetze ObservableObject durch das @Observable-Macro.
translations.it: Sostituisci ObservableObject con il macro @Observable.

english: Wrap this view in a ScrollView with a scroll target behavior.
context: Using new SwiftUI scroll APIs

translations.pt-BR: Envolva essa view num ScrollView com scroll target behavior.
translations.es: Envuelve esta vista en un ScrollView con un scroll target behavior.
translations.fr: Enveloppe cette vue dans un ScrollView avec un scroll target behavior.
translations.de: Wickle diese View in eine ScrollView mit Scroll Target Behavior.
translations.it: Avvolgi questa view in uno ScrollView con scroll target behavior.

english: Use the new TabView API with the sidebar adaptable style.
context: Adopting modern multi-platform tab navigation in SwiftUI

translations.pt-BR: Use a nova API de TabView com o estilo adaptável de sidebar.
translations.es: Usa la nueva API de TabView con el estilo adaptable de sidebar.
translations.fr: Utilise la nouvelle API TabView avec le style adaptable sidebar.
translations.de: Nutze die neue TabView-API mit dem adaptiven Sidebar-Stil.
translations.it: Usa la nuova API TabView con lo stile sidebar adattabile.

english: Add a sensoryFeedback modifier to trigger haptics on state change.
context: Replacing manual UIFeedbackGenerator with SwiftUI's declarative haptics

translations.pt-BR: Adicione um modifier sensoryFeedback pra disparar haptics quando o estado muda.
translations.es: Agrega un modifier sensoryFeedback para disparar haptics cuando cambie el estado.
translations.fr: Ajoute un modifier sensoryFeedback pour déclencher des haptics au changement d'état.
translations.de: Füge einen sensoryFeedback-Modifier hinzu, um Haptics bei Statusänderung auszulösen.
translations.it: Aggiungi un modifier sensoryFeedback per attivare l'haptic al cambio di stato.

english: The new MeshGradient lets us build organic backgrounds in pure SwiftUI.
context: Discussing visual design using SwiftUI 2026 gradient API

translations.pt-BR: O novo MeshGradient permite criar backgrounds orgânicos em SwiftUI puro.
translations.es: El nuevo MeshGradient nos permite construir fondos orgánicos en SwiftUI puro.
translations.fr: Le nouveau MeshGradient permet de créer des arrière-plans organiques en pur SwiftUI.
translations.de: Mit dem neuen MeshGradient lassen sich organische Hintergründe in reinem SwiftUI bauen.
translations.it: Il nuovo MeshGradient ci permette di creare sfondi organici in SwiftUI puro.

english: Mark this function async so we can await the network call.
context: Adopting Swift Concurrency for async I/O

translations.pt-BR: Marque essa função como async pra podermos dar await na chamada de rede.
translations.es: Marca esta función como async para poder hacer await en la llamada de red.
translations.fr: Marque cette fonction async pour pouvoir await l'appel réseau.
translations.de: Markiere diese Funktion als async, damit wir den Netzwerkaufruf awaiten können.
translations.it: Segna questa funzione come async per poter fare await sulla chiamata di rete.

english: Wrap mutable state inside an actor to make it Sendable.
context: Resolving data race warnings with Swift 6 strict concurrency

translations.pt-BR: Envolva o estado mutável dentro de um actor pra torná-lo Sendable.
translations.es: Envuelve el estado mutable dentro de un actor para hacerlo Sendable.
translations.fr: Encapsule l'état mutable dans un actor pour le rendre Sendable.
translations.de: Kapsele veränderlichen Zustand in einem Actor, um ihn Sendable zu machen.
translations.it: Incapsula lo stato mutabile dentro un actor per renderlo Sendable.

english: Enable strict concurrency checking before migrating to Swift 6.
context: Preparing a project for the Swift 6 language mode

translations.pt-BR: Ative strict concurrency checking antes de migrar pro Swift 6.
translations.es: Activa el strict concurrency checking antes de migrar a Swift 6.
translations.fr: Active la vérification stricte de concurrence avant de migrer vers Swift 6.
translations.de: Aktiviere Strict Concurrency Checking, bevor du auf Swift 6 migrierst.
translations.it: Attiva lo strict concurrency checking prima di migrare a Swift 6.

english: Run these requests concurrently with a TaskGroup.
context: Parallelizing async work in Swift

translations.pt-BR: Rode essas requisições concorrentemente com um TaskGroup.
translations.es: Ejecuta estas solicitudes en paralelo con un TaskGroup.
translations.fr: Exécute ces requêtes en parallèle avec un TaskGroup.
translations.de: Führe diese Requests gleichzeitig mit einer TaskGroup aus.
translations.it: Esegui queste richieste in parallelo con un TaskGroup.

english: Mark this type Sendable so it can cross actor boundaries safely.
context: Annotating types for Swift Concurrency safety

translations.pt-BR: Marque esse tipo como Sendable pra poder cruzar fronteiras de actor com segurança.
translations.es: Marca este tipo como Sendable para que pueda cruzar fronteras de actor de forma segura.
translations.fr: Marque ce type Sendable pour qu'il puisse traverser les frontières d'actor en sécurité.
translations.de: Markiere diesen Typ als Sendable, damit er Actor-Grenzen sicher überqueren kann.
translations.it: Segna questo tipo come Sendable per attraversare i confini degli actor in sicurezza.

english: Use @MainActor to guarantee this runs on the main thread.
context: Annotating UI-bound code with the main actor

translations.pt-BR: Use @MainActor pra garantir que isso rode na main thread.
translations.es: Usa @MainActor para garantizar que esto se ejecute en el hilo principal.
translations.fr: Utilise @MainActor pour garantir que ça tourne sur le thread principal.
translations.de: Verwende @MainActor, um sicherzustellen, dass das auf dem Main Thread läuft.
translations.it: Usa @MainActor per garantire che venga eseguito sul main thread.

english: Cancel the task when the view disappears to avoid leaks.
context: Lifecycle management for async tasks in SwiftUI

translations.pt-BR: Cancele a task quando a view desaparecer pra evitar leaks.
translations.es: Cancela la task cuando la vista desaparezca para evitar leaks.
translations.fr: Annule la tâche quand la vue disparaît pour éviter les leaks.
translations.de: Brich die Task ab, wenn die View verschwindet, um Leaks zu vermeiden.
translations.it: Annulla la task quando la view scompare per evitare memory leak.

english: AsyncSequence makes streaming data feel native to Swift.
context: Praising the ergonomics of Swift's async iteration

translations.pt-BR: AsyncSequence faz com que streaming de dados pareça nativo do Swift.
translations.es: AsyncSequence hace que el streaming de datos se sienta nativo de Swift.
translations.fr: AsyncSequence rend le streaming de données vraiment natif en Swift.
translations.de: AsyncSequence lässt Daten-Streaming sich wie natives Swift anfühlen.
translations.it: AsyncSequence fa sembrare nativo lo streaming di dati in Swift.

english: Expose this feature as an App Intent so Siri can trigger it.
context: Integrating an action with the App Intents framework

translations.pt-BR: Exponha essa funcionalidade como um App Intent pra Siri poder disparar.
translations.es: Expón esta funcionalidad como un App Intent para que Siri pueda activarla.
translations.fr: Expose cette fonctionnalité en tant qu'App Intent pour que Siri puisse la déclencher.
translations.de: Stelle dieses Feature als App Intent bereit, damit Siri es auslösen kann.
translations.it: Esponi questa funzionalità come App Intent così che Siri possa attivarla.

english: Define an AppShortcutsProvider to register your shortcuts at install time.
context: Surfacing app actions in the Shortcuts app automatically

translations.pt-BR: Defina um AppShortcutsProvider pra registrar seus shortcuts no momento da instalação.
translations.es: Define un AppShortcutsProvider para registrar tus shortcuts al instalar.
translations.fr: Définis un AppShortcutsProvider pour enregistrer tes shortcuts dès l'installation.
translations.de: Definiere einen AppShortcutsProvider, um deine Shortcuts beim Installieren zu registrieren.
translations.it: Definisci un AppShortcutsProvider per registrare i tuoi shortcut all'installazione.

english: The intent parameter resolves through a dynamic options provider.
context: Building dynamic Shortcuts that fetch options at runtime

translations.pt-BR: O parâmetro do intent é resolvido via um dynamic options provider.
translations.es: El parámetro del intent se resuelve mediante un dynamic options provider.
translations.fr: Le paramètre de l'intent se résout via un dynamic options provider.
translations.de: Der Intent-Parameter wird über einen Dynamic Options Provider aufgelöst.
translations.it: Il parametro dell'intent si risolve tramite un dynamic options provider.

english: Add interactive buttons to your widget with App Intents.
context: Building interactive widgets without launching the host app

translations.pt-BR: Adicione botões interativos no seu widget usando App Intents.
translations.es: Agrega botones interactivos a tu widget usando App Intents.
translations.fr: Ajoute des boutons interactifs à ton widget grâce aux App Intents.
translations.de: Füge deinem Widget interaktive Buttons mit App Intents hinzu.
translations.it: Aggiungi pulsanti interattivi al tuo widget usando gli App Intent.

english: Use @Parameter to declare the inputs your intent expects.
context: Wiring up parameters for an App Intent

translations.pt-BR: Use @Parameter pra declarar os inputs que seu intent espera.
translations.es: Usa @Parameter para declarar los inputs que tu intent espera.
translations.fr: Utilise @Parameter pour déclarer les entrées attendues par ton intent.
translations.de: Verwende @Parameter, um die Eingaben deines Intents zu deklarieren.
translations.it: Usa @Parameter per dichiarare gli input che il tuo intent si aspetta.

english: The donate API tells the system this action is worth suggesting.
context: Improving Siri suggestions via intent donation

translations.pt-BR: A API de donate diz pro sistema que essa ação vale a pena ser sugerida.
translations.es: La API de donate le indica al sistema que esta acción vale la pena sugerirla.
translations.fr: L'API donate indique au système que cette action vaut la peine d'être suggérée.
translations.de: Die Donate-API teilt dem System mit, dass diese Aktion vorgeschlagen werden sollte.
translations.it: L'API donate dice al sistema che questa azione vale la pena di essere suggerita.

english: Localize your intent's display representation in all supported languages.
context: Making intents discoverable across regions

translations.pt-BR: Localize o display representation do seu intent em todos os idiomas suportados.
translations.es: Localiza la display representation de tu intent en todos los idiomas soportados.
translations.fr: Localise la display representation de ton intent dans toutes les langues supportées.
translations.de: Lokalisiere die Display Representation deines Intents in allen unterstützten Sprachen.
translations.it: Localizza la display representation del tuo intent in tutte le lingue supportate.

english: We're prototyping a visionOS companion app.
context: Announcing exploratory spatial-computing work

translations.pt-BR: A gente tá prototipando um app companion pra visionOS.
translations.es: Estamos prototipando una app compañera para visionOS.
translations.fr: On prototype une app compagnon pour visionOS.
translations.de: Wir prototypen eine Companion-App für visionOS.
translations.it: Stiamo prototipando un'app companion per visionOS.

english: Use a RealityView to embed 3D content alongside SwiftUI.
context: Mixing 2D and 3D UI on Vision Pro

translations.pt-BR: Use uma RealityView pra embarcar conteúdo 3D junto com SwiftUI.
translations.es: Usa un RealityView para incrustar contenido 3D junto con SwiftUI.
translations.fr: Utilise une RealityView pour intégrer du contenu 3D aux côtés de SwiftUI.
translations.de: Verwende eine RealityView, um 3D-Inhalte neben SwiftUI einzubetten.
translations.it: Usa una RealityView per integrare contenuti 3D accanto a SwiftUI.

english: Open an immersive space to take over the user's environment.
context: Transitioning a visionOS app to a fully immersive experience

translations.pt-BR: Abra um immersive space pra ocupar o ambiente do usuário.
translations.es: Abre un immersive space para tomar el control del entorno del usuario.
translations.fr: Ouvre un immersive space pour prendre le contrôle de l'environnement de l'utilisateur.
translations.de: Öffne einen Immersive Space, um die Umgebung des Nutzers einzunehmen.
translations.it: Apri un immersive space per prendere il controllo dell'ambiente dell'utente.

english: Anchor this entity to the user's hand using ARKit.
context: Spatial anchoring on Vision Pro

translations.pt-BR: Ancore essa entity na mão do usuário usando ARKit.
translations.es: Ancla esta entity a la mano del usuario usando ARKit.
translations.fr: Ancre cette entity à la main de l'utilisateur via ARKit.
translations.de: Verankere diese Entity an der Hand des Nutzers mit ARKit.
translations.it: Ancora questa entity alla mano dell'utente usando ARKit.

english: Test the app in the Vision Pro simulator before requesting a dev kit.
context: Planning visionOS development without physical hardware

translations.pt-BR: Teste o app no simulador do Vision Pro antes de pedir um dev kit.
translations.es: Prueba la app en el simulador del Vision Pro antes de pedir un dev kit.
translations.fr: Teste l'app dans le simulateur Vision Pro avant de demander un dev kit.
translations.de: Teste die App im Vision-Pro-Simulator, bevor du ein Dev Kit anforderst.
translations.it: Testa l'app nel simulatore di Vision Pro prima di richiedere un dev kit.

english: Use windowed and volumetric scenes side by side.
context: Designing multi-scene visionOS apps

translations.pt-BR: Use scenes windowed e volumétricas lado a lado.
translations.es: Usa scenes windowed y volumétricas lado a lado.
translations.fr: Utilise des scenes windowed et volumétriques côte à côte.
translations.de: Verwende Windowed- und Volumetric-Scenes nebeneinander.
translations.it: Usa scene windowed e volumetriche fianco a fianco.

english: Gaze and pinch is the primary input model on Vision Pro.
context: Explaining spatial interaction patterns

translations.pt-BR: Gaze e pinch é o modelo principal de input no Vision Pro.
translations.es: Gaze y pinch es el modelo principal de input en el Vision Pro.
translations.fr: Gaze et pinch sont le modèle d'input principal sur Vision Pro.
translations.de: Gaze und Pinch sind das primäre Input-Modell auf der Vision Pro.
translations.it: Gaze e pinch sono il modello di input principale su Vision Pro.

english: Apple Intelligence runs on-device whenever possible.
context: Explaining the privacy posture of Apple's AI stack

translations.pt-BR: O Apple Intelligence roda on-device sempre que possível.
translations.es: Apple Intelligence se ejecuta on-device siempre que es posible.
translations.fr: Apple Intelligence s'exécute on-device chaque fois que c'est possible.
translations.de: Apple Intelligence läuft wenn möglich on-device.
translations.it: Apple Intelligence gira on-device ogni volta che è possibile.

english: Call the Foundation Models framework to access the on-device language model.
context: Integrating Apple's local LLM into your app

translations.pt-BR: Chame o framework Foundation Models pra acessar o language model on-device.
translations.es: Llama al framework Foundation Models para acceder al language model on-device.
translations.fr: Appelle le framework Foundation Models pour accéder au language model on-device.
translations.de: Rufe das Foundation-Models-Framework auf, um auf das On-Device-Language-Model zuzugreifen.
translations.it: Chiama il framework Foundation Models per accedere al language model on-device.

english: Writing Tools work in any text view that adopts TextEditor.
context: Explaining how Apple Intelligence text features integrate

translations.pt-BR: As Writing Tools funcionam em qualquer text view que adote TextEditor.
translations.es: Las Writing Tools funcionan en cualquier text view que adopte TextEditor.
translations.fr: Les Writing Tools fonctionnent dans n'importe quelle text view utilisant TextEditor.
translations.de: Writing Tools funktionieren in jeder Text View, die TextEditor verwendet.
translations.it: I Writing Tools funzionano in qualsiasi text view che adotti TextEditor.

english: Use Image Playground to let users generate custom images in your app.
context: Adopting Apple's on-device image generation API

translations.pt-BR: Use Image Playground pra deixar os usuários gerarem imagens custom no seu app.
translations.es: Usa Image Playground para que los usuarios generen imágenes personalizadas en tu app.
translations.fr: Utilise Image Playground pour permettre aux utilisateurs de générer des images personnalisées.
translations.de: Nutze Image Playground, damit Nutzer eigene Bilder in deiner App generieren können.
translations.it: Usa Image Playground per permettere agli utenti di generare immagini personalizzate nella tua app.

english: Genmoji lets users create custom emoji on the fly.
context: Describing a new Apple Intelligence consumer feature

translations.pt-BR: O Genmoji permite que usuários criem emojis customizados na hora.
translations.es: Genmoji permite a los usuarios crear emojis personalizados al momento.
translations.fr: Genmoji permet aux utilisateurs de créer des emojis personnalisés à la volée.
translations.de: Genmoji erlaubt Nutzern, eigene Emojis spontan zu erstellen.
translations.it: Genmoji permette agli utenti di creare emoji personalizzate al volo.

english: Private Cloud Compute extends the on-device model for heavier prompts.
context: Discussing Apple's secure off-device compute layer

translations.pt-BR: O Private Cloud Compute estende o modelo on-device pra prompts mais pesados.
translations.es: Private Cloud Compute extiende el modelo on-device para prompts más pesados.
translations.fr: Private Cloud Compute étend le modèle on-device pour les prompts plus lourds.
translations.de: Private Cloud Compute erweitert das On-Device-Modell für anspruchsvollere Prompts.
translations.it: Private Cloud Compute estende il modello on-device per prompt più pesanti.

english: Use guided generation to constrain the model output to a Codable type.
context: Getting structured output from the Foundation Models framework

translations.pt-BR: Use guided generation pra restringir o output do modelo a um tipo Codable.
translations.es: Usa guided generation para restringir el output del modelo a un tipo Codable.
translations.fr: Utilise guided generation pour contraindre la sortie du modèle à un type Codable.
translations.de: Nutze Guided Generation, um die Modellausgabe auf einen Codable-Typ zu beschränken.
translations.it: Usa guided generation per vincolare l'output del modello a un tipo Codable.

english: Always disclose that your feature uses AI in the App Store description.
context: Following Apple's App Store guidelines for AI features

translations.pt-BR: Sempre informe que a sua feature usa IA na descrição da App Store.
translations.es: Siempre indica que tu feature usa IA en la descripción de la App Store.
translations.fr: Indique toujours que ta fonctionnalité utilise l'IA dans la description App Store.
translations.de: Gib in der App-Store-Beschreibung immer an, dass dein Feature KI verwendet.
translations.it: Dichiara sempre nella descrizione dell'App Store che la tua feature usa l'IA.

english: Use @Model to make your type SwiftData-managed.
context: Adopting SwiftData for persistence

translations.pt-BR: Use @Model pra que seu tipo seja gerenciado pelo SwiftData.
translations.es: Usa @Model para que tu tipo sea gestionado por SwiftData.
translations.fr: Utilise @Model pour que ton type soit géré par SwiftData.
translations.de: Verwende @Model, damit dein Typ von SwiftData verwaltet wird.
translations.it: Usa @Model perché il tuo tipo sia gestito da SwiftData.

english: Expand the macro in Xcode to debug the generated code.
context: Debugging Swift macros at compile time

translations.pt-BR: Expanda a macro no Xcode pra debugar o código gerado.
translations.es: Expande el macro en Xcode para depurar el código generado.
translations.fr: Étends le macro dans Xcode pour déboguer le code généré.
translations.de: Erweitere das Macro in Xcode, um den generierten Code zu debuggen.
translations.it: Espandi il macro in Xcode per fare debug del codice generato.

english: Typed throws let you specify exactly what errors a function can throw.
context: Adopting Swift's typed throws feature

translations.pt-BR: Typed throws permite especificar exatamente quais erros uma função pode lançar.
translations.es: Los typed throws permiten especificar exactamente qué errores puede lanzar una función.
translations.fr: Les typed throws permettent de spécifier exactement quelles erreurs une fonction peut lancer.
translations.de: Mit Typed Throws gibst du exakt an, welche Fehler eine Funktion werfen kann.
translations.it: I typed throws permettono di specificare esattamente quali errori una funzione può lanciare.

english: Migrate this NSObject subclass to a pure Swift struct.
context: Modernizing legacy Objective-C bridging code

translations.pt-BR: Migre essa subclasse de NSObject pra uma struct Swift pura.
translations.es: Migra esta subclase de NSObject a un struct Swift puro.
translations.fr: Migre cette sous-classe NSObject vers un struct Swift pur.
translations.de: Migriere diese NSObject-Subklasse zu einem reinen Swift-Struct.
translations.it: Migra questa sottoclasse di NSObject a uno struct Swift puro.

english: I'll catch up on sessions on the WWDC app during my commute.
context: Planning post-keynote study time

translations.pt-BR: Vou pôr as sessions em dia no app do WWDC durante o trajeto.
translations.es: Voy a ponerme al día con las sessions en la app de WWDC durante el viaje.
translations.fr: Je vais rattraper les sessions sur l'app WWDC pendant les trajets.
translations.de: Ich hole die Sessions in der WWDC-App während meines Arbeitswegs nach.
translations.it: Recupererò le sessioni nell'app del WWDC durante il tragitto.

english: Let's open a watch party for the keynote in the office.
context: Organizing a team viewing for the WWDC opening

translations.pt-BR: Bora abrir uma watch party do keynote aqui no escritório.
translations.es: Vamos a organizar una watch party del keynote en la oficina.
translations.fr: On organise une watch party du keynote au bureau.
translations.de: Lass uns eine Watch-Party für die Keynote im Büro veranstalten.
translations.it: Organizziamo un watch party del keynote in ufficio.

english: Apple released a beta of the new SDK right after the keynote.
context: Tracking the developer beta release cycle

translations.pt-BR: A Apple lançou um beta do novo SDK logo após o keynote.
translations.es: Apple lanzó un beta del nuevo SDK justo después del keynote.
translations.fr: Apple a sorti une bêta du nouveau SDK juste après le keynote.
translations.de: Apple hat direkt nach der Keynote eine Beta des neuen SDK veröffentlicht.
translations.it: Apple ha rilasciato una beta del nuovo SDK subito dopo il keynote.

english: Filing radars during the beta cycle is how we shape the final API.
context: Encouraging team to file Feedback Assistant reports

translations.pt-BR: Abrir radars durante o ciclo de beta é como a gente molda a API final.
translations.es: Abrir radars durante el ciclo de beta es cómo damos forma a la API final.
translations.fr: Ouvrir des radars pendant le cycle bêta, c'est comme ça qu'on façonne l'API finale.
translations.de: Radars während des Beta-Zyklus zu öffnen, ist wie wir die finale API mitgestalten.
translations.it: Aprire radar durante il ciclo di beta è il modo in cui modelliamo l'API finale.

english: Sample code projects ship the same day the sessions go live.
context: Pointing teammates to Apple's sample code resources

translations.pt-BR: Os projetos de sample code são publicados no mesmo dia que as sessions ficam disponíveis.
translations.es: Los proyectos de sample code se publican el mismo día que se publican las sessions.
translations.fr: Les projets de sample code sortent le jour même de la publication des sessions.
translations.de: Sample-Code-Projekte erscheinen am selben Tag wie die Sessions.
translations.it: I progetti di sample code escono lo stesso giorno della pubblicazione delle sessioni.

english: We'll cherry-pick the most impactful APIs into our roadmap.
context: Deciding which new SDK features to prioritize after WWDC

translations.pt-BR: Vamos selecionar as APIs mais impactantes pra colocar no nosso roadmap.
translations.es: Vamos a seleccionar las APIs más impactantes para nuestro roadmap.
translations.fr: On va cherry-picker les API les plus impactantes dans notre roadmap.
translations.de: Wir picken die wirkungsvollsten APIs für unsere Roadmap heraus.
translations.it: Selezioneremo le API più impattanti da inserire nella nostra roadmap.
